stem: The number of absences per week by workers at a factory has the distribution $\text{Po}(2.1)$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the standard deviation of the number of absences per week.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the number of absences in a 2-week period is at least 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Find the probability that the number of absences in a 3-week period is more than 4 and less than 8.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Following a change in working conditions, the management wished to test whether the mean number of absences has decreased. They found that, in a randomly chosen 3-week period, there were exactly 2 absences.
parts.text: Carry out the test at the 10% significance level.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: State, with a reason, which of the errors, Type I or Type II, might have been made in carrying out the test in part **(d)**.
